_comment: Committed receipts recorded before v0.10.101 that contain a Capy machine path (a /workspace/ checkout, or ~/.capy/ or $HOME/.capy/ scratch): MACHINE_LOCAL_PATH did not match those forms until then. They are kept byte-for-byte as historical evidence. One of them, the 2026-10-10-memory-proof-wave-lme-facts0 re-judge ledger status, was recorded on 2026-10-10 on branch capy/mpw-harness and reached main on 2026-10-31. No other receipt may contain such a path, and these files may not change.
